title: Pilot slice: Cloud-first policy analysis run
objective: Route a Cloud-first planning task to the cloud execution lane once prerequisite gates pass.
acceptance_criteria: The issue routes deterministically to the cloud lane.
Cloud-first remains the primary lane for the routed work.
The issue can be escalated to ready-for-human if the cloud lane is unavailable.

focus: Schema validation succeeds for Cloud-first routing metadata.
Primary execution lane resolves to cloud-first.
Cloud fallback to ready-for-human is defined for blocked or saturated execution.
